description:
Somos o maior ressegurador do Brasil. Com mais de 80 anos de experiência, atuamos nas principais linhas de negócios em resseguros e contamos com uma equipe altamente qualificada, pronta para inovar e oferecer os melhores produtos e serviços ao mercado.


Estamos com 1 vaga de Especialista em Provisões Técnicas, com foco em IFRS17 . Confira os detalhes abaixo:


FORMAÇÃO ACADÊMICA


  • Necessário superior completo em Ciências Atuariais;
  • Desejável pós-graduação ou especialização em Ciências Atuariais, Estatística, Finanças, Economia, Seguros, Resseguros ou Engenharia.

title: Sales Engineer
description:
About Credix

Credix is a FinTech company dedicated to growing businesses in Latin America. Building on our expertise, we now focus on providing a tailored Buy Now, Pay Later (BNPL) solution for B2B transactions in Brazil with our platform, CrediPay . CrediPay is created to help business grow their sales and improve their cashflow efficiency through seamless and risk-free credit offering. Sellers offer their buyers flexible payment terms at an attractive price point and receive upfront payments. We manage and protect our clients from any credit & fraud risk, letting them focus only on what matters: increased sales and profitability.


Why choose Credix?

  • Become part of a forward-thinking start-up where boldness and a commitment to excellence are paramount, and your personal and professional development is at the forefront.
  • Work alongside a dedicated team of bright individuals driven by an Olympian mindset to excel in every aspect of our operations. Together, we aim to build with velocity, utilizing innovative embedded finance strategies to expand business operations in Latin America.
  • Experience a close and supportive work atmosphere where collaboration thrives, wise judgment guides our decisions, and you can learn, grow, and take on meaningful responsibilities.


About the job

We are looking for someone to join Credix as a Sales Engineer . You will own the technical success of client integrations, from pre-sales feasibility to production go-live, ensuring fast activation and long-term integration stability.


Responsibilities

  • Technical pre-sales validation: Lead technical pre-sales by validating feasibility, defining integration scope, and identifying risks before commercial commitment.
  • Integration delivery and go-live readiness: Support sellers through implementation and testing, and act as the technical authority to approve or block go-live based on readiness criteria.
  • Post-go-live integration reliability: Ensure the ongoing health of live integrations by owning issue triage, resolution, or escalation within 24 business hours.
  • Feedback loop to Product and Engineering: Translate integration learnings into actionable feedback to improve platform reliability, scalability, and integration speed.
  • Align technical decisions with commercial outcomes: Partner closely with Sales and Account Managers to ensure integrations support activation, retention, and GMV growth.
  • Customer-facing engagement: Frequently travel to customer sites across Brazil to support integrations, technical alignment, and relationship building.


Qualifications

  • Strong experience working with REST APIs, including authentication, webhooks, error handling, and data modeling.
  • Prior exposure to complex system integrations, preferably in e-commerce platforms (e.G., VTEX) or ERPs.
  • Comfortable working with SQL to investigate integration behavior, validate data flows, and support issue triage using BI tools such as Hex or equivalent.
  • Able to use monitoring and logging tools (e.G., Kibana or equivalent) to identify, diagnose, and communicate production integration issues.
  • Able to produce clear, concise, and structured technical documentation for external partners and internal teams.
  • Organized, proactive, and reliable in driving integrations forward across multiple stakeholders.
  • Curious about customer contexts and constraints, while able to design pragmatic, repeatable integration solutions rather than one-off custom builds.
  • Prioritizes customer success while balancing platform scalability, reliability, and long-term architectural constraints.
  • Operates with high autonomy and ownership, demonstrating strong prioritization, self-direction, and accountability while executing against ambitious targets.


What we offer

Collaboration and team spirit thrive best in an in-office environment. Our office provides a vibrant and engaging workspace where team members can connect, innovate, and grow. With access to our offices in Sao Paulo, you’ll immerse yourself in a culture of innovation and collaboration.


But that’s just the beginning - here’s what else we offer:

- A culture of learning and experimentation: where you are encouraged to explore new ideas and technologies

- Competitive salary package: Your hard work deserves recognition, and we ensure you’re well-rewarded for your contributions.

- Equity stock options plan: Be a part of our journey towards success and share in the rewards.

- Paid holidays: Enjoy the flexibility to recharge and rejuvenate

- Off-sites: Awesome team building, unforgettable memories, and adventures ensured during our team off-sites.

title: Alloy Welder

  • Complete and turn in timesheets for job cost tracking in a timely manner.
  • Varying degrees of precision and control is required.
  • Support assembly functions as required by the Production Manager.
  • Offsite/offshore travel as required.


Requirements

Must successfully complete welding tests to perform job duties.

title: Analista Técnico De Subscrição Júnior - Vida
description:
Somos a Seguros Unimed, a Seguradora do Sistema Unimed, uma empresa criada por médicos e que tem o cooperativismo na essência.   • Vale Refeição e Alimentação;

  • Gympass e Totalpass;

Além disso, você encontra por aqui:

  • Trilha de desenvolvimento;

  • Ambiente de Trabalho Inovador;

  • Subscrever riscos com projeção de sinistralidade futura, ponderando a experiência da carteira

da Seguradora e do cliente potencial.   • Conhecer os princípios e normas estabelecidas pela SUSEP (Superintendência de Seguros

Privados);

  • Realizar diligência do cliente e dados fornecidos com buscas na Internet e estudos anteriores;
  • Garantir a melhor experiência no atendimento ao cliente interno. Ser viabilizador de negócios,

mantendo a sustentabilidade da seguradora;

  • Visão holística do processo, com gestão do tempo e qualidade;
  • Identificar e propor inovações para o desenvolvimento da área/seguradora;
  • Realizar a análise do seguro de vida/pessoas com base nos dados encaminhados, estudos

anteriores e pesquisas na internet, segundo técnicas específicas de análise de riscos e de acordo com a Política de Subscrição da Seguradora;

  • Cumprir os regulamentos internos, normas e procedimentos, bem como as observações dos

requisitos de Compliance;

  • Realizar atendimento de acordo com as demandas, identificando as principais particularidades

de cada região, visando atendimento personalizado;

  • Assegurar o atendimento dentro dos prazos acordados;
  • Atender aos clientes internos (Atuarial, Comercial, Licitações, Unidade de Regulação Médica,

Financeiro, Produtos, Gestão de Riscos e Compliance, entre outras), dando suporte a quaisquer esclarecimentos sobre processos, fluxos e subscrição de riscos;

  • Dar suporte direto ao coordenador, gerente e superintendente, quando necessário.


Esperamos de você:

  • Ensino Superior Completo, preferencialmente em Administração de Empresas, Ciências

Atuariais, Economia ou áreas correlatas;

  • Vivência anterior na área;
  • Garantir a melhor experiência no atendimento ao cliente interno;
  • Apoiar na viabilização de negócios, mantendo a sustentabilidade da seguradora;
  • Visão sistêmicado processo, com gestão do tempo e qualidade;
  • Iniciativa e resolutividade;
  • Identificar e propor inovações para o desenvolvimento da área/seguradora;
  • Capacidade de se comunicar de forma clara e objetiva;
  • Domínio do Pacote Office, especialmente Excel, para análise de dados e relatórios.



Informações adicionais:

  • Vaga extensiva a Pessoas com Deficiência - PCD;
  • Tipo de contrato: CLT;
  • Modelo híbrido de trabalho (03 dias presenciais, 02 home office);
  • Horário de trabalho: de segunda a sexta-feira, comercial flex;
  • Local de trabalho: Jardins, próximo ao metrô Consolação - Av. Paulista;
  • Todos os nossosprocessos seletivos são totalmente on-line nas etapas iniciais.


A Seguros Unimed respeita a pluralidade de identidades e trabalha para promover uma cultura inclusiva. Não fazemos distinção de raça, cor, religião, identidade de gênero, orientação sexual, nacionalidade, deficiência ou idade em nenhuma etapa do processo seletivo, reforçando nosso compromisso de uma empresa focada em cooperar e no seu cliente interno e externo.

  • Certificação obrigatória: CPA-20
  • Formação em Administração, Economia ou áreas correlacionadas.
  • Conhecimento em produtos de investimento (renda fixa, renda variável, fundos, etc.).
  • Perfil comercial, com boa comunicação e capacidade de relacionamento.

title: Coordenador Agrícola - Ctt
description:
Somos Atvos!


Na Atvos, produzimos e comercializamos etanol, açúcar VHP e energia elétrica a partir da cana-de-açúcar e da biomassa. Nossa energia vai além do negócio: está nas pessoas e no nosso jeito de ser. Com capacidade para abastecer mais de 60 milhões de carros com etanol, adoçar milhões de festas com nosso açúcar e levar energia para o bem-estar de mais de 20 milhões de pessoas, também somos destaque na emissão de CBIOs. Atuamos com responsabilidade, desenvolvendo comunidades, cuidando do meio ambiente e transformando vidas. Aqui na Atvos lideramos a transição energética para mover o mundo e transformar vidas.


Confira mais da nossa empresa pelo site:


#VemPraAtvos


Aqui, diversidade é essencial! Nossas vagas são destinadas a todos, com incentivo á participação de mulheres e PCDs.


Descrição da Vaga

Estamos em busca de um(a) Coordenador(a) Agrícola – CTT para atuar na gestão da operação de colheita, transbordamento e transporte de cana-de-açúcar, garantindo a eficiência operacional, segurança das pessoas e cumprimento das metas produtivas. Esse(a) profissional terá papel estratégico na mitigação de riscos operacionais, especialmente relacionados às condições climáticas, além de liderar equipes operacionais e acompanhar indicadores de desempenho da área.


Responsabilidades e Atribuições:

  • Coordenar as operações de colheita mecanizada, transbordamento e transporte de cana-de-açúcar (CTT), assegurando produtividade, qualidade e eficiência operacional.
  • Garantir o cumprimento rigoroso das normas de Segurança, Saúde e Meio Ambiente (SSMA), promovendo uma cultura de segurança no campo.
  • Atuar de forma preventiva na mitigação de riscos operacionais, especialmente aqueles impactados por condições climáticas e restrições operacionais.
  • Planejar, dimensionar e otimizar recursos operacionais (equipes, máquinas, frota e turnos).
  • Liderar, desenvolver e engajar equipes operacionais, incluindo supervisores, líderes e operadores, garantindo alinhamento às metas e padrões da companhia.
  • Monitorar, analisar e reportar indicadores de performance (KPIs), propondo planos de ação e iniciativas de melhoria contínua.
  • Garantir a eficiência da logística interna do CTT, otimizando recursos e reduzindo perdas operacionais.
  • Atuar de forma integrada com áreas correlatas, apoiando o planejamento da safra, a tomada de decisão e o cumprimento do orçamento.
  • Contribuir para o controle de custos operacionais e para decisões estratégicas relacionadas à operação agrícola.


Requisitos e Qualificações:

  • Formação superior completa em Engenharia Agronômica, Engenharia Agrícola, Engenharia de Produção, Administração ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência sólida em operações de colheita, transbordamento e transporte (CTT) no setor sucroenergético.
  • Conhecimento prático em operações mecanizadas de cana-de-açúcar e logística agrícola.
  • Vivência em gestão de equipes operacionais e liderança em ambientes de campo.
  • Conhecimento e aplicação das normas de SSMA no ambiente agrícola.
  • Capacidade analítica para acompanhamento de indicadores, análise de dados e gestão de resultados.
  • Disponibilidade para atuação predominantemente em campo.
  • Disponibilidade para residir em Alto Taquari (MT) ou Alto Araguaia (MT).


Informações adicionais:

Vaga presencial para a nossa unidade de Alto Taquari/MT. Oferecemos pacote de mudança.


Benefícios que fortalecem nossa energia

Na Atvos, acreditamos que cuidar das pessoas é essencial para transformar o amanhã . Por isso, oferecemos um pacote de benefícios pensado para apoiar seu bem-estar, desenvolvimento e qualidade de vida dentro e fora do campo ou do escritório.

Aqui, crescer com consistência significa unir inovação, sustentabilidade e propósito para gerar impacto positivo nas pessoas, nos negócios e no planeta.

title: Border Patrol Agent
description:
Border Patrol Agent (BPA) Entry LevelNEW RECRUITMENT AND RETENTION INCENTIVES!IMPORTANT NOTICE : Duty assignments available at the time of offer may include the Southwest Border, including prioritized locations.U.S. Border Patrol determines duty assignments at the time of offer based on operational needs, which may or may not align with candidates' first-choice preferences. Relocation may be required.DON'T FORGET TO CHECK OUT THE INCENTIVES - SEE SALARY SECTION BELOWThe U.S. Border Patrol (USBP) offers those interested in a career in law enforcement an opportunity to work with an elite team of highly trained professionals whose camaraderie, pride, and purpose are hallmarks of their daily mission of protecting America.If you seek an exciting and rewarding job that provides excellent pay, exceptional federal benefits, and job stability, now is the time to make your move. U.S. Border Patrol (USBP), within the U.S. Customs and Border Protection (CBP), is hiring immediately for these full-time, entry-level, career Law Enforcement Officer (LEO) opportunities.Salary and BenefitsAnnual Base Salary for newly appointed BPAs varies per grade, as follows:GL-5/GL-7 $49,739 - $89,518 per yearDuty location impacts pay rates;
locality pay for federal law enforcement is higher in some locations than others. A fully trained BPA may be eligible for up to an additional 25% of base pay per the BPA Pay Reform Act of 2014. This is a career ladder position with a grade level progression of GL-5, GL-7, GL-9, GS-11, and GS-12. You will be eligible for a promotion to the next higher grade level (without reapplying) once you successfully complete 52 weeks in each grade level.Border Patrol Agents are eligible to select from an array of federal employment benefits that include health, dental and other insurance plans, a generous annual and sick leave program, and participation in the Thrift Savings Plan, a retirement plan akin to a traditional ROTH 401(k) offering.*Recruitment Incentive* Newly appointed Border Patrol Agents (as defined in 5 CFR 575.102 ( ) will be offered up to a $20,000 incentive. The first $10,000 will be paid upon successful completion of the Border Patrol Academy, with the remaining $10,000 awarded for accepting a prioritized location. Prioritized locations include Sierra Blanca, TX;
Presidio, TX;
Sanderson, TX;
Comstock, TX;
Lordsburg, NM;
Freer, TX;
Hebbronville, TX;
Ajo, AZ.*Retention Incentive* Newly appointed Border Patrol Agents may also qualify for up to $40,000 in additional incentives distributed over their first four years.Duties and ResponsibilitiesAs a BPA, you will be part of our 60,000+ workforce that strives to protect the American people by safeguarding our borders, deterring illicit activity, and enhancing the nation's economic prosperity. Being a BPA makes you a valuable member of the Federal Law Enforcement Officer (LEO) profession.Typical assignments include:* Detecting and questioning people suspected of violating immigration and custom laws and inspecting documents and possessions to determine citizenship or violations* Preventing and apprehending undocumented noncitizens and smugglers of noncitizens at or near the borders by maintaining surveillance from covert positions to include using infrared scopes during night operations* Interpreting and following tracks, marks, and other physical evidence of illegal entry of persons or contraband* Performing farm checks, building checks, traffic checks, city patrols, and transportation checks* Patrolling the international boundary and coastal waterways using a variety of government assets such as vehicles, horses, vessels, watercraft, off-road vehicles, ATVs, snowmobiles, and motorcycles for the accomplishment of the USBP Mission.QualificationsYou qualify for the GL-5 grade level if you possess one of the following:Experience : One (1) year of general work experience that demonstrates the ability to take charge, make sound decisions, and maintain composure in stressful situations;
to learn regulations, methods, and techniques through classroom training and/or on-the-job instruction;
and the ability to gather concise information through questioning, observation, and examination of documents and records;
OREducation Substitution : A bachelor's degree or successful completion of a full four-year course of study in any field leading to a bachelor's degree from an accredited college or university;
ORCombination of Experience and Education : A combination of general work experience AND successfully completed college education. This will be calculated using your resume and official or unofficial transcripts submitted with your application.You qualify for the GL-7 grade level if you possess one of the following:Experience : One year of specialized work experience that shows you have the skills necessary to:* Make sound judgments and decisions in the use of firearms.* Deal effectively with people in a courteous and tactful manner in connection with law enforcement matters.* Analyze information rapidly and make prompt decisions where you will be expected to make arrests after the completion of required training and apply these skills in a law enforcement capacity such as criminal code enforcement, determining violations of laws, correctional or rehabilitation work involving criminal offenders, security, military, etc.The above experience will be applied in connection with the following: Make arrests and exercise sound judgment in the use of firearms;
deal effectively with people in a courteous manner in connection with law enforcement matters;
analyze information rapidly and make prompt decisions;
or develop and maintaincontact with a network of informants.Education Substitution for the GL-7 grade level : A bachelor's degree with superior academic achievement, which is based on (1) class standing, (2) grade-point average (i.E., GPA of 3.0 or higher out of a possible 4.0), or (3) honor society membership. Or will receive a bachelor's degree with Superior Academic Achievement. Or one full year of graduate-level education in a field of study related to law enforcement (e.G., criminal justice, homeland security, justice studies, law enforcement, courts and judicial systems, forensic technology, forensic psychology, or corrections and rehabilitation) from an accredited college or university;
ORA Combination of Experience and Education : This will be calculated using your resume and official or unofficial transcripts submitted with your application.Note : If you have previous or current law enforcement or military law enforcement experience, you may qualify at the GL-9 and or GS-11 grade level. Please refer to the BPA GL-9 - 11 announcement.Other RequirementsCitizenship : You must be a U.S. Citizen to apply for this position.Residency : You must have had primary U.S. residency (includes protectorates as declared under international law) for at least three of the last five years.Age Restrictio n: In accordance with Public Law 100-238, this position is covered under law enforcement retirement provisions. Candidates must be referred for selection to the Border Patrol Agent position before reaching their 40th birthday in accordance with Department of Homeland Security Directive 251-03. The age restriction may not apply if you are currently serving or have previously served in a federal civilian law enforcement (non-military) position covered by Title 5 U.S.C. 8336(c) or Title 5 U.S.C. 8412(d).Veterans' Preference : You may also be eligible for an excepted service Veterans Recruitment Appointment (VRA). The age restriction does not apply if you are Veterans' Preference eligible.Formal Training : After you are hired, you will be detailed to the U.S. Border Patrol Academy in Artesia, New Mexico, for approximately six (6) months of intensive instruction in immigration and nationality laws, law enforcement and USBP-specific operations, driver training, physical techniques, firearms, and other courses. Border Patrol work requires the ability to speak and read Spanish, as well as English. Border Patrol Agents will be provided training to become proficient with the Spanish language at the Academy.How to Apply:Click the Apply button on this site. You will be linked to the CBP Talent Network registration page. For Position of Interest, select Border Patrol Agent, then complete the pre-screening questions.You'll then receive a link(s) to the BPA Job Opening Announcements (JOAs) on USAJOBS, the federal government's official employment site, to complete your application. Be certain to review ALL details of the job opportunity announcement and follow all instructions in the application process, including items (resume, transcripts, etc.) to submit. You will be evaluated based on your resume, supporting documents, and the BPA Entrance Exam.If you have questions about the application process, contact a recruiter through the U.S. Border Patrol page: careers.Cbp.Gov/s/usbp.As a subscriber to the CBP Talent Network, you'll receive monthly emails with information about webinars, career expos, and future opportunities with CBP.

Lordsburg, NM;
Freer, TX;

Ajo, AZ.*Retention Incentive* Newly appointed Border Patrol Agents may also qualify for up to $40,000 in additional incentives distributed over their first four years.Duty Locations: You will be asked to select your preferred location for one of the following mission critical locations:* Big Bend Sector Stations - *Presidio, Van Horn, *Sanderson, Alpine, *Sierra Blanca, Marfa* Buffalo Sector Stations - Wellesley Island* Del Rio Sector Stations - Del Rio, Brackettville, *Comstock, Eagle Pass North, Eagle Pass South, Carrizo Springs, Uvalde* El Paso Sector Stations - Alamogordo, Clint, Deming, El Paso, Fort Hancock, Las Cruces, *Lordsburg, Santa Teresa, Ysleta* El Centro Sector Stations - El Centro, Indio, Calexico* Grand Forks Sector Stations - Pembina* Havre Sector Stations - Havre, Malta, Plentywood, Scobey, Sweetgrass* Houlton Sector Stations - Calais, Fort Fairfield, Jackman, Rangeley, Van Buren* Laredo Sector Stations - Laredo South, Cotulla, *Hebbronville, Laredo West, *Freer, Laredo North, Zapata* Rio Grande Valley Sector Stations - Rio Grande City, Fort Brown, McAllen, Brownsville, Falfurrias, Weslaco, Kingsville, Harlingen* San Diego Sector Stations - Boulevard, Brownfield, Campo, Chula Vista, Imperial Beach, Murrieta, San Clemente* Spokane Sector Stations - Colville, Curlew, Metaline Falls, Oroville* Swanton Sector Stations - Beecher Falls, Burke, Champlain, Newport, Richford* Tucson Sector Stations - *Ajo, Tucson, Nogales, Douglas, Brian A Terry, Sonoita, Casa Grande, Three Points Substation, Willcox* Yuma Sector Stations - Blythe, Yuma, WelltonDuties and Responsibilities:As a BPA, you will be part of our 60,000+ workforce that strives to protect the American people by safeguarding our borders, deterring illicit activity, and enhancing the nation's economic prosperity. Being a BPA makes you a valuable member of the Federal Law Enforcement Officer (LEO) profession.Typical assignments include:* Detecting and questioning people suspected of violating immigration and customs laws and inspecting documents and possessions to determine citizenship or violations.* Preventing and apprehending aliens and smugglers of aliens at or near the borders by maintaining surveillance from covert positions to include using infrared scopes during night operations.* Interpreting and following tracks, marks, and other physical evidence of illegal entry of persons or contraband.* Performing farm checks, building checks, traffic checks, city patrols, and transportation checks.* Patrolling the international boundary and coastal waterways using a variety of government assets such as vehicles, horses, vessels, watercraft, off-road vehicles, ATVs, snowmobiles, and motorcycles for the accomplishment of the USBP Mission.Qualifications:GL-9: You qualify for individuals, their vehicles, and their immediate surroundings for weapons, contraband, currency, and other evidence.* Apprehending, physically restraining, or working with law enforcement officials to identify or apprehend violators of state, federal, or immigration laws.* Proficient in the use of firearms, preparing investigative reports, serving court orders (e.G., warrants, subpoenas, etc.), and gathering evidence for criminal cases prosecuted through the court system.If you have previous or current law enforcement or military law enforcement experience, you may qualify at the GS-11 grade level.GS-11: You qualify for the GS-11 grade level if you possess one year of specialized experience equivalent to at least the next lower grade level, with the authority granted by the state or government to enforce laws, make arrests, and investigate crimes, performing primary duties in an official law enforcement capacity such as:* Utilizing intelligence information to track illegal operations, criminal activity, threats to our nation, and/or contraband while serving as a state, federal, or military law enforcement official.* Leading investigations of fraud, contraband, criminal activity, threats to our nation, and/or illegal operations to determine sources and patterns while serving as a state, federal, or military law enforcement official.* Apprehending violators of state, federal, or immigration laws by utilizing various forms of complex technology that include surveillance, detection, situation awareness systems, and/or communications equipment.The above experience will be applied in connection with the following: Make arrests and exercise sound judgment in the use of firearms;
deal effectively with people in a courteous manner in connection with law enforcement matters;
analyze information rapidly and make prompt decisions;
or develop and maintaincontact with a network of informants.There are no education substitutions for the GL-9 or GS-11 grade-level Border Patrol Agent opportunities.Other Requirements:Citizenship: You must be a U.S. Citizen to apply for this position.Residency: You must have had primary U.S. residency (including protectorates as declared under international law) for at least three of the last five years.Age Restriction: In accordance with Public Law 100-238, this position is covered under law enforcement retirement provisions. Border Patrol work requires the ability to speak and read Spanish, as well as English. Border Patrol Agents will be provided training to become proficient in the Spanish language at the Academy.How to Apply:Click the Apply button on this site. title: Border Patrol Agent - Experienced
description:
Border Patrol Agent (BPA) - Experienced (GL-9 GS-11)NEW RECRUITMENT AND RETENTION INCENTIVES!Check out these higher-salaried federal law enforcement opportunities with the U.S. Customs and Border Protection. Your current or prior law enforcement experience may qualify you for this career opportunity with the nation's premier federal agency charged with securing our borders and protecting our country.You may qualify for these higher-graded Border Patrol Agent (BPA) employment opportunities if you have current or prior law enforcement experience. This experience could have been gained as part of a military police assignment or as a member of a state or local law enforcement organization. Look at the duties and responsibilities section below to see if you are interested in these federal law enforcement opportunities and review the qualifications section below to see if you are qualified.>
DON'T FORGET TO CHECK OUT THE INCENTIVES - SEE SALARY SECTION BELOWIMPORTANT NOTICE: Duty assignments available at the time of offer may include the Southwest Border, including prioritized locations.U.S. Border Patrol determines duty assignments at the time of offer based on operational needs, which may or may not align with candidates' first-choice preferences. Relocation may be required.The U.S. Border Patrol (USBP) offers those interested in a career in law enforcement an opportunity to work with an elite team of highly trained professionals whose camaraderie, pride, and purpose are hallmarks of their daily mission of protecting America.If you seek an exciting and rewarding job that provides excellent pay and exceptional federal benefits, now is the time to make your move. U.S. Customs and Border Protection (CBP) is hiring immediately for these full-time, career Law Enforcement Officer (LEO) opportunities.Salary and Benefits:Salary for newly appointed law enforcement Border Patrol Agents varies from:Base Salary: GL-9/GS-11 $63,148 - $120,145 per yearLocality Pay: Varies by duty location.Overtime Pay: Up to 25%Duty location impacts pay rates;
locality pay for federal law enforcement is higher in some locations than others. A fully trained BPA may be eligible for up to an additional 25% of base pay per the BPA Pay Reform Act of 2014. This is a career ladder position with a grade level progression from GL-9 to GS-11 to GS-12. You will be eligible for a promotion to the next higher grade level (without re-applying) once you successfully complete 52 weeks in the lower grade level.All Border Patrol Agents may select from an array of federal employment benefits that include health and insurance plans, a generous annual and sick leave program, and participation in the Thrift Savings Plan, a retirement plan that is similar to traditional and ROTH 401(k) offerings.*Recruitment Incentive* Newly appointed Border Patrol Agents (as defined in 5 CFR 575.102 ( ) will be offered up to a $20,000 incentive. The first $10,000 will be paid upon successful completion of the Border Patrol Academy, with the remaining $10,000 awarded for accepting a prioritized location. Prioritized locations include Sierra Blanca, TX;
Presidio, TX;
Sanderson, TX;
Comstock, TX;
Lordsburg, NM;
Freer, TX;
Hebbronville, TX;
Ajo, AZ.*Retention Incentive* Newly appointed Border Patrol Agents may also qualify for up to $40,000 in additional incentives distributed over their first four years.Duties and Responsibilities:As a BPA, you will be part of our 60,000+ workforce that strives to protect the American people by safeguarding our borders, deterring illicit activity, and enhancing the nation's economic prosperity. Being a BPA makes you a valuable member of the Federal Law Enforcement Officer (LEO) profession.Typical assignments include:* Detecting and questioning people suspected of violating immigration and customs laws and inspecting documents and possessions to determine citizenship or violations.* Preventing and apprehending aliens and smugglers of aliens at or near the borders by maintaining surveillance from covert positions to include using infrared scopes during night operations.* Interpreting and following tracks, marks, and other physical evidence of illegal entry of persons or contraband.* Performing farm checks, building checks, traffic checks, city patrols, and transportation checks.* Patrolling the international boundary and coastal waterways using a variety of government assets such as vehicles, horses, vessels, watercraft, off-road vehicles, ATVs, snowmobiles, and motorcycles for the accomplishment of the USBP Mission.Qualifications:GL-9: You qualify for the GL-9 grade level if you possess one (1) year of specialized experience, equivalent to at least the next lower grade level, performing duties such as:* Performing physical searches of detained individuals, their vehicles, and their immediate surroundings for weapons, contraband, currency, and other evidence.* Apprehending, physically restraining, or working with law enforcement officials to identify or apprehend violators of state, federal, or immigration laws.* Proficient in the use of firearms, preparing investigative reports, serving court orders (e.G., warrants, subpoenas, etc.), and gathering evidence for criminal cases prosecuted through the court system.If you have previous or current law enforcement or military law enforcement experience, you may qualify at the GS-11 grade level.GS-11: You qualify for the GS-11 grade level if you possess one year of specialized experience equivalent to at least the next lower grade level, with the authority granted by the state or government to enforce laws, make arrests, and investigate crimes, performing primary duties in an official law enforcement capacity such as:* Utilizing intelligence information to track illegal operations, criminal activity, threats to our nation, and/or contraband while serving as a state, federal, or military law enforcement official.* Leading investigations of fraud, contraband, criminal activity, threats to our nation, and/or illegal operations to determine sources and patterns while serving as a state, federal, or military law enforcement official.* Apprehending violators of state, federal, or immigration laws by utilizing various forms of complex technology that include surveillance, detection, situation awareness systems, and/or communications equipment.The above experience will be applied in connection with the following: Make arrests and exercise sound judgment in the use of firearms;
deal effectively with people in a courteous manner in connection with law enforcement matters;
analyze information rapidly and make prompt decisions;
or develop and maintaincontact with a network of informants.There are no education substitutions for the GL-9 or GS-11 grade-level Border Patrol Agent opportunities.Other Requirements:Citizenship: You must be a U.S. Citizen to apply for this position.Residency: You must have had primary U.S. residency (including protectorates as declared under international law) for at least three of the last five years.Age Restriction : In accordance with Public Law 100-238, this position is covered under law enforcement retirement provisions. Candidates must be referred for selection to the Border Patrol Agent position before reaching their 40th birthday in accordance with Department of Homeland Security Directive 251-03. The age restriction may not apply if you are currently serving or have previously served in a federal civilian law enforcement (non-military) position covered by Title 5 U.S.C. 8336(c) or Title 5 U.S.C. 8412(d).Veterans' Preference : You may also be eligible for an excepted service Veterans' Recruitment Appointment (VRA). The age restriction does not apply if you are Veterans' Preference eligible.Formal Training : After you are hired, you will be detailed to the U.S. Border Patrol Academy in Artesia, New Mexico, for approximately six (6) months of intensive instruction in immigration and nationality laws, law enforcement, and USBP-specific operations, driver training, physical techniques, firearms, and other courses. Border Patrol work requires the ability to speak and read Spanish, as well as English. Border Patrol Agents will be provided training to become proficient in the Spanish language at the Academy.How to Apply:Click the Apply button on this site. You will be linked to the CBP Talent Network registration page. For Position of Interest, select Border Patrol Agent, and then complete the pre-screening questions.You'll then receive a link(s) to the BPA Job Opening Announcements (JOAs) on USAJOBS, the federal government's official employment site, to complete your application. Be certain to review ALL details of the job opportunity announcement and follow all instructions in the application process, including items (resume, transcripts, etc.) to submit. You will be evaluated based on your resume, supporting documents, and the BPA Entrance Exam.If you have questions about the application process, contact a recruiter through the U.S. Border Patrol page: careers.Cbp.Gov/s/usbp.NOTE: As a subscriber to the CBP Talent Network, you'll receive monthly emails with information about webinars, career expos, and future opportunities with CBP.

title: Finance Business Partner
description:
About the Role

We are looking for a highly driven Finance Business Partner to support strategic business initiatives and international expansion. This role will act as a trusted advisor to business leaders, ensuring financial rigor while enabling fast, sustainable growth.


You will operate at the intersection of finance and strategy — shaping investment decisions, strengthening financial governance, and delivering insights that directly influence business performance.


This position is ideal for finance professionals who combine strong analytical capabilities with a commercial mindset and thrive in dynamic, high-growth environments.


Key Responsibilities

  • Strategic Financial Partnership: Partner with business leaders across the full financial lifecycle — from planning to execution — providing actionable insights that support data-driven decision-making.
  • Financial Governance & Process Excellence: Design, implement, and continuously optimize financial processes, policies, and controls to enhance operational efficiency while ensuring compliance.
  • Expansion & Market Launch Support: Lead financial readiness for launches in new countries and cities by establishing scalable frameworks, enabling operational continuity, and proactively managing financial risks.
  • Investment Evaluation & Business Case Development: Assess new business opportunities by evaluating investment requirements, expected returns, and financial viability. Provide clear recommendations to support strategic growth initiatives.
  • Budgeting & Forecasting Ownership: Drive the annual budgeting process and rolling forecasts, partnering closely with stakeholders to ensure disciplined financial management and strong resource allocation.
  • Advanced Business Analysis: Build robust financial analysis models to monitor performance, identify opportunities, highlight risks, and guide leadership on profitability and cost optimization.
  • Cross-functional Leadership: Collaborate closely with Accounting, Tax, Treasury, Reporting, and Internal Controls to ensure alignment with regulatory requirements and corporate standards.
  • Finance Digitalization: Contribute to the evolution of financial systems and tools by defining analytical and monitoring requirements that improve transparency and decision support.


Basic Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or a related field.
  • Robust experience in Finance Business Partnering or similar strategic finance roles.
  • Solid knowledge of financial regulations within Brazil.
  • Strong business acumen with the ability to translate complex financial data into strategic recommendations.
  • Advanced analytical skills with proficiency in financial systems and data analysis tools.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence cross-functional teams.
  • Highly adaptable, proactive, and comfortable operating in fast-paced, evolving environments.
  • Professional fluency in English.
  • Experience in high-growth industries such as technology, e-commerce, logistics, on-demand platforms, or internet companies .


Why Join Us

  • Be part of a rapidly scaling global business with significant international growth ambitions.
  • Operate as a strategic partner , influencing key investment and operational decisions.
  • Gain broad exposure across financial disciplines while supporting complex, cross-border initiatives.
  • High-impact role with strong visibility among senior stakeholders.

title: Alliances Director
description:
Transforming the Future of Enterprise Planning


At o9, our mission is to be the Most Value-Creating Platform for enterprises by transforming decision-making through our AI-first approach. By integrating siloed planning capabilities and capturing millions—even billions—in value leakage, we help businesses plan smarter and faster.


This not only enhances operational efficiency but also reduces waste, leading to better outcomes for both businesses and the planet. Global leaders like Google, PepsiCo, Walmart, T-Mobile, AB InBev, and Starbucks trust o9 to optimize their supply chains.


Alliances Director


At o9, we invest in people. We seek talented, driven individuals to power our transformative approach. You’ll thrive in a dynamic, supportive environment, growing while making a real impact.


What you’ll do for us

  • Develop long-term vision and goals for company growth and Alliance partnerships.
  • Create and implement viable business plans to ensure long-term goals are realized.
  • Maintain and nurture relationships with Alliance Partner senior leaders to ensure all parties are satisfied with progress and outcome of partnerships.
  • Responsible for securing external partnerships including contacting key stakeholders, securing appointments, developing proposals, making presentations, and negotiating business deals to contract completion.
  • Maintain and expand key stakeholder contact networks and work closely with internal teams to identify and expand networks.
  • Be the representative of o9 and encourage our Alliance Partners (such as Accenture, Deloitte, Genpact, Microsoft, and others) wherever you go.
  • Conduct introductory and second level training and demos for our Alliance Partners, their Industry/Client Leads and Teams.
  • Develop joint proposals, project plans and offerings for prospects and partners.
  • Visit partners and attend events throughout the region.
  • Coordinate and manage go-to-market programs with Alliance Partners.
  • Gain thorough knowledge about the o9 platform and its value.


What you’ll have

  • Education: A Bachelor’s degree in supply chain management, business, entrepreneurship or other applicable discipline. Master’s degree preferred.
  • Experience: 8+ years of experience with Executive Sales, Project Management and/or sales consulting background. Proven track record in the supply chain industry is a must.
  • Experience successfully developing and implementing go-to-market strategies.
  • Skills: Strategic thinker who is able to blend consulting and business strategy to develop compelling plans for new partner initiatives.
  • Demonstrated ability to develop and lead multiple strategic partnerships.
  • Demonstrated and thorough knowledge of industry best practices, business processes, and value propositions in supply chain and process optimization.
  • Disciplined and structured in mapping out key stakeholders to engage with.


What We Offer

  • Competitive Salary – We recognize and reward talent.
  • Tech Tools – Choose a Windows or PC laptop, whatever helps you work best.
  • Flexible Work – Work from home two days a week—less commuting, more time for what matters.
  • Supportive Team – Work alongside a diverse, talented team you can learn from every day.
  • Diversity & Inclusion – We celebrate our international workforce and value different perspectives.
  • Food & Drink – Enjoy healthy snacks, fresh fruit, teas, and coffees.


How the process works

  • Apply – Submit your application by clicking the Link below.
  • Initial Contact – Our recruiter will connect with you via video or phone call to discuss the role and understand your background.
  • Online Assessment - (If Applicable)
  • During the interview phase, you will meet with the technical panel for 60 minutes. We will contact you after the interview to let you know if we’d like to progress your application.
  • Tech Round 1 – An initial technical discussion to evaluate your skills and expertise.
  • Tech Round 2 – A deeper technical assessment to understand your approach and proficiency.
  • Managerial Round – A conversation with the hiring manager to evaluate collaboration, team fit, and growth potential.
  • HR Round – A final discussion on company culture, expectations, and career progression.


More about us…


At o9, transparency and open communication are at the core of our culture. Collaboration thrives across all levels—hierarchy, distance, or function never limit innovation or teamwork. Beyond work, we encourage volunteering opportunities, social impact initiatives, and diverse cultural celebrations.


With a $3.7 billion valuation and a global presence across Dallas, Amsterdam, Barcelona, Madrid, London, Paris, Tokyo, Seoul, and Munich, o9 is among the fastest-growing technology companies in the world. Through our aim10x vision, we are committed to AI-powered management, driving 10x improvements in enterprise decision-making. Our Enterprise Knowledge Graph enables businesses to anticipate risks, adapt to market shifts, and gain real-time visibility. By automating millions of decisions and reducing manual interventions by up to 90%, we empower enterprises to drive profitable growth, reduce inefficiencies, and create lasting value.


o9 is an equal-opportunity employer that values diversity and inclusion. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds, ensuring a fair and unbiased hiring process. Join us as we continue our growth journey!

title: Vp Engineering, Ai, Data & Platform Architecture
description:
About HYPR


HYPR is a technology leader at the intersection of AI, data, and location intelligence. It operates a proprietary end-to-end platform connecting physical-world behavior, offline transactions, mobile signals, and omnichannel media execution. Nine-figure annual revenue, category leader in physical retail media and incrementality measurement.


Our Platform


The company's core software and data platform. Where data is ingested, models are trained, decisions are made, and products are delivered at scale. Underpins critical business functions (measurement, optimization, activation, decisioning) and represents the technical foundation for HYPR's long-term differentiation.


The Role


Owner and responsible for scaling HYPR Cloud Platform. Board-level executive role with end-to-end accountability for architecture, development, and operation of AI systems directly supporting strategy, revenue, and competitive advantage.

Designed for a founder-grade technical leader, hands-on, with technical depth to design systems, judgment for high-impact long-term decisions, and credibility to operate as a peer to executive leadership.


This is not:

  • A pure research role
  • A purely managerial role
  • A position for empire-building


This is:

  • A build-and-own mandate


Mission


Design, build, and scale AI-native software platforms that convert HYPR's proprietary data advantage into durable, defensible, and monetizable systems — with world-class engineering standards, execution speed, and economic discipline.


What You Will Own


  • HYPR Cloud architecture (AI/ML, data platforms, APIs, production systems)
  • Technical strategy aligned with board objectives and long-term direction
  • Reliability, scalability, performance, and cost efficiency of all AI systems
  • Hiring, development, and leadership of a small, elite, senior engineering organization
  • Translation of ambiguous, high-impact business problems into production-grade systems
  • Platform evolution, technical risk management, and architectural integrity at scale


How You Will Drive Impact


  • Define and evolve durable architecture for AI-native adtech and location-intelligence platforms
  • Lead productionization of AI models (LLMs, proprietary models, hybrid systems) embedded directly in decision workflows
  • Integrate foundation models with structured, geospatial, transactional, and mobile data
  • Build and operate high-throughput, low-latency data pipelines for real-time and batch decisioning
  • Establish engineering standards for quality, security, observability, MLOps, and system reliability
  • Make build vs buy, stack, and cloud economics decisions with long-term leverage in mind
  • Partner directly with Board and executive leadership on platform strategy and technical bets
  • Maintain execution velocity while preventing uncontrolled technical debt
  • Ensure systems are economically efficient, not just technically sophisticated


Leadership Expectations


  • Operate as a technical executive with direct involvement in architecture and system design
  • Be hands-on in critical technical decisions and reviews
  • Build, mentor, and retain senior engineers and technical leaders with strong ownership
  • Establish a culture of accountability, craftsmanship, and outcome-driven engineering
  • Communicate complex technical trade-offs clearly to executives and board members


Experience and Profile


Deep experience building and operating complex software, data platforms, or AI systems in production, with demonstrated ability to own platform-level decisions with material business impact. Strong expertise in distributed systems, modern cloud platforms (GCP/AWS), and data-intensive architectures. Hands-on experience deploying and integrating LLM-based and machine learning systems in real-world environments.

Proven track record of high-impact technical decisions and translating ambiguous business problems into durable, scalable systems. Depth of experience, judgment, and execution capability matter more than years in role.

Experience in location-based platforms is highly valued, as well as experience with geospatial data, mobile SDKs, or large-scale behavioral datasets. Prior founder, co-founder, or early-stage executive experience is a strong plus, as is exposure to global, multi-market platforms.


Compensation and Governance


Executive role reporting directly to the Executive Board, with significant autonomy over technical and organizational decisions. Total annual compensation is expected to exceed BRL 1,000,000, including base salary, performance-based incentives, and long-term equity, structured to align leadership incentives with company growth and platform impact.

title: Network Engineer
description:
Network Engineer – LAN/WAN (Senior / Level 3)

Role Overview

We are seeking an experienced Senior Network Engineer (LAN/WAN) to join our global infrastructure team. In this role, you will design, deploy, and maintain complex network environments while providing advanced Level 3 support for critical incidents. You will work closely with cross‑functional teams, vendors, and internal stakeholders to ensure high availability, security, and performance across enterprise network systems.


Key Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and deploy LAN/WAN network infrastructure across enterprise environments.
  • Provide 3rd level troubleshooting for all LAN/WAN issues, alerts, and escalations.
  • Maintain and support all network monitoring and reporting systems .
  • Produce and maintain detailed technical documentation for all deployed systems and solutions.
  • Participate in on‑call rotations and provide after‑hours support as required.
  • Perform administrative tasks including time reporting and status updates.
  • Configure and install a wide range of network components (routers, switches, firewalls, load balancers, VPN, QoS).
  • Execute network maintenance, upgrades, patches, hotfixes, and security configurations.
  • Monitor network performance, ensuring system availability, reliability, and capacity planning .
  • Follow established change and configuration management processes for all network modifications.
  • Work with the security team to implement security tools, policies, and best practices.
  • Collaborate with vendors and internal IT teams to resolve complex issues.
  • Deliver technical training to internal teams.


Technical Qualifications

  • Strong networking background with CCNP certification (required) .
  • Excellent troubleshooting skills with the ability to quickly diagnose and repair network issues.
  • Ability to communicate with customers, gather requirements, and collaborate with offshore teams.
  • Experience with SD‑WAN (Silver Peak preferred) .
  • Experience with Next‑Gen Firewalls (Cisco Firepower preferred) .
  • Hands-on experience troubleshooting routing loops, asymmetric routing, and STP loop issues.
  • Expertise configuring/troubleshooting:
  • Cisco ASA, IPS
  • Cisco ISE
  • Cisco WLC (wireless)
  • Routing protocols: EIGRP, OSPF, BGP
  • LAN switching: VLAN, VTP, STP, EtherChannel
  • Quality of Service (QoS)
  • TCP/IP stack
  • Application protocols: HTTP, HTTPS, FTP, SMTP, SNMP, SSL, etc.
  • Network security: IPSec/SSL VPN, Cisco AnyConnect, AAA, TACACS+, RADIUS, 802.1x
  • Experience with Cisco Catalyst and Nexus 7K/9K switches .
  • Skilled in Cisco IOS and NX‑OS configuration and troubleshooting.
  • Experience with application load balancers and firewall cloud services (Zscaler preferred ).
  • Data Center networking experience (Nexus / ACI preferred ).
  • Ability to support enterprise apps such as SAP, Citrix, Portal, etc.
  • Ability to analyze monitoring outputs and recommend actions (e.G., CPU spikes on core devices).
  • Cloud experience in AWS, GCP, or Azure is a plus.
  • Hands-on experience with Citrix NetScaler, Cisco FTD, Aruba SD‑WAN, and Azure Cloud considered a strong advantage.


General Qualifications

  • Strong team player with excellent collaboration skills.
  • Ability to interact directly with end users to troubleshoot and resolve issues.
  • Excellent documentation and reporting skills.
  • Self‑starter with strong initiative and problem‑solving mindset.
  • Exceptional communication and presentation abilities.
  • Ability to learn new technologies quickly in a dynamic environment.


Education Requirements

  • CCNP Certification (required)
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or related field.
  • Advanced English.


Igualdade & Oportunidade para Todos

Representando 165 nacionalidades em todo o mundo, nos orgulhamos de ser um empregador que oferece igualdade de oportunidades, comprometido em fornecer oportunidades iguais de emprego a todos os candidatos e funcionários, independentemente de raça, religião, sexo, cor, idade, nacionalidade, gravidez, orientação sexual, deficiência física ou informações genéticas, ou qualquer outra classificação protegida, de acordo com as leis federais, estaduais e/ou locais.

title: Senior Finance Business Partner
description:
About the Role

We are seeking a Senior Finance Business Partner to support our rapidly growing Customer Service platform across multiple countries. This role sits at the intersection of finance and operations, acting as a strategic advisor to business leaders while ensuring strong financial governance, scalable processes, and disciplined cost management.


The ideal candidate brings deep Finance BP experience, thrives in fast-paced environments, and demonstrates strong business acumen — particularly within customer-centric or service-driven organizations.


Key Responsibilities

  • Strategic Finance Partnership: Partner closely with the multi-country Customer Service leadership team to drive financial planning, improve decision-making, and embed financial discipline into daily operations.
  • Financial Process Optimization: Design, implement, and continuously improve financial processes, policies, and controls. Provide expert guidance to support sustainable and compliant business growth.
  • Market Expansion Support: Lead financial readiness for launches in new countries or cities by establishing scalable frameworks, ensuring operational continuity, and proactively mitigating financial risks.
  • Cross-functional Collaboration: Work in close partnership with Accounting, Tax, Treasury, Reporting, and Internal Controls teams to ensure regulatory compliance and alignment with corporate standards.
  • Budgeting & Forecasting Leadership: Own the annual budgeting cycle and rolling forecasts for the Customer Experience (CE) business. Build a robust budget management structure and partner with stakeholders to drive accountability and financial performance.
  • Advanced Financial Analysis: Develop a comprehensive financial analysis framework to evaluate business performance, identify risks and opportunities, and deliver actionable insights — with a strong focus on cost efficiency and operational productivity within customer service environments.
  • Data & Financial Digitalization: Contribute to the evolution of financial systems and digital tools by defining analytical and monitoring requirements that enhance visibility and decision support.


Basic Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or a related field.
  • Solid experience in Finance Business Partnering or similar strategic finance roles.
  • Proven exposure to multi-country or regional operations .
  • Strong business judgment with the ability to translate financial data into strategic recommendations.
  • Excellent stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence senior leaders.
  • Advanced analytical capabilities and proficiency with financial and data analysis tools.
  • Highly adaptable, proactive, and comfortable operating in dynamic, high-growth environments.
  • Professional fluency in English.
  • Experience managing finance for customer service, contact centers, shared services, or operations-heavy businesses .
  • Background in multinational or high-growth technology, e-commerce, logistics, or platform companies.


Why Join Us

  • Scale with a high-growth global business: Play a key role in supporting rapidly expanding international operations.
  • True business exposure: Operate as a strategic partner with direct impact on operational and financial outcomes.
  • Broad finance scope: Gain hands-on experience across multiple finance disciplines while shaping scalable frameworks for the future.
  • High visibility: Collaborate with senior stakeholders and influence critical business decisions.

title: Gerente De Inteligência De Negócios - Bi
description:
Referência em inovação, criatividade e respeito às diferenças, o Publicis Groupe é o grupo de comunicação mais valorizado no mercado. Atuamos com base na filosofia do Power of One, que permite que as marcas avancem na personalização em escala e encontrem todos os serviços de que precisam no mesmo lugar, com a possibilidade de customizá-los de acordo com suas demandas.

No Brasil, o Publicis Groupe conta com 2.500 colaboradores divididos em agências de publicidade e empresas especialistas que são referências em suas áreas de atuação: DPZ, LePub, Leo, Publicis Brasil, Talent, ARC, BR Media, Epsilon, PMX, PXP e Publicis Edge.

A Publicis Edge é a marca que nasceu na Ásia e hoje tem presença na China, em Singapura, na Austrália e no Brasil, com a missão de oferecer soluções proprietárias para acelerar a transformação dos negócios dos clientes em áreas como mídia preditiva, social, commerce e retail media.



Resumo da Posição

A pessoa contratada será responsável por liderar a área de BI, garantindo a qualidade, integração e governança dos dados, além de transformar informações de mídia e analytics em insights estratégicos para o negócio. Atuará de forma consultiva junto aos times internos e clientes, apoiando decisões de mídia, entendimento de audiências e otimização de campanhas, com foco em inovação, automação e evolução contínua dos processos de inteligência.



Requisitos

  • Formação superior completa, preferencialmente em Publicidade, Marketing, estatística ou Engenharia.
  • Habilidade analítica para interpretar dados e formular hipóteses;
  • Conhecimentos avançados em Google Analytics, Google Tag Manager, Google Looker Studio ou Power BI;
  • Conhecimento avançado em plataformas de mídia para mensuração e coleta de dados, como Facebook Business, Google Ads, DV 360, entre outras;
  • Experiência emgestão de pauta, processos e organização de demandas;
  • Competência emcriar storytelling e apresentar dados de forma impactante;
  • Excelentes habilidades de relacionamento, com comunicação clara e senso de urgência;
  • Habilidade em conceber e planejar visualizações de dados para orientar a equipe técnica;
  • Entendimento do contexto de mídia paga, orgânica e pós-clique com plataformas de web analytics, buy-side platforms, CDPs, DMPs, estudos de Brandlift e ferramentas de verificação de anúncios e segurança de marca;
  • Conhecimento em estratégias de marketing e negócios, e operação de tecnologia e dados em agências de publicidade;
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas de agência como TGI, Comscore, Monitorar, Semrush, SimilarWeb, etc;
  • Capacidade de desenvolver uma visão estratégica baseada em dados;
  • Comunicação deintermediário para avançada em inglês.




Principais Responsabilidades

  • Liderar e supervisionar a equipe de BI, promovendo desenvolvimento e capacitação;
  • Facilitar um ambiente colaborativo e fomentar a inovação dentro da equipe;
  • Garantir a obtenção, processamento e análise de dados precisos para gerar insights de negócios;
  • Liderar o desenvolvimento de dashboards e relatórios juntamente ao time de Supervisores e Analistas de BI da conta, garantindo que as entregas atendam às necessidades do cliente;
  • Estabelecer e manter padrões de qualidade e integridade dos dados, respeitando os guidelines de taxonomia e processamento existentes do cliente e agência;
  • Implantar políticas de governança de dados para assegurar conformidade e segurança.
  • Coordenar a integração de diversas fontes de dados de mídia e web analytics assegurando a centralização das informações;
  • Realizar análises aprofundadas sobre o público-alvo target e segmentações em colaboração com time de Pesquisa de Mídia e outras áreas correlatas do Hub de Dados
  • Conduzir estudos detalhados sobre o público-alvo e segmentação de audiências para otimizar estratégias de mídia e identificar padrões comportamentais e preferências;
  • Monitorar juntamente aos demais times de dados e inteligência, tendências de mercado e atividades da concorrência para identificar novas oportunidades e insights para os times de estratégia e mídia;
  • Medir e analisar o desempenho das campanhas de mídia, fornecendo recomendações para melhorias;
  • Estruturar e revisar processos atuais e futuros pertinentes a área, focando em automação e otimização.



Diferenciais:

  • Fluência em inglês e espanhol, considerando a necessidade de interações contínuas com equipes globais e do Publicis Groupe.
  • Experiência em projetos de automação e engenharia de dados voltados para mídia e marketing.
  • Conhecimentos avançados em plataformas de social listening.
  • Conhecimentos avançados em SEO e ferramentas de SEM.
  • Experiência com plataformas ou elaboração de estudos de MMM (Media Mix Modeling)



Aqui valorizamos:

  • Diversidade de trajetórias
  • Comunicação clara e empática
  • Colaboração e autonomia



Local de trabalho:

Berrini - Zona Sul - SP

Modelo de trabalho: Hibrido

Todas as nossas vagas são abertas a pessoas de todas as identidades de gênero, orientações afetivas, raças, etnias, idades, religiões, pessoas com deficiência, entre outras. Acreditamos que equipes diversas constroem soluções mais criativas e humanas.

Auxílio internet

Desconto em farmácias

Day off de aniversário e no aniversário de filhos(as), independente da idade

Plataforma para desenvolvimento de carreira e educação

️ ♂️ Plataforma de acesso a estúdios e academias

⚕️Plataforma virtual de acesso a médicos e especialistas

Telepsicologia e acompanhamento nutricional

✨ E muito mais!


Nosso compromisso com você:

No Publicis Groupe, acreditamos que o sucesso começa com pessoas bem cuidadas, ouvidas e inspiradas. Aqui, nos preocupamos com a sua jornada, por isso, trazemos alguns dos pilares que sustentam nossa cultura:

Diversidade e pertencimento: programas como Viva La Difference, Entre e Ampliar reforçam nosso compromisso com inclusão, equidade e representatividade.

Impacto com responsabilidade: atuamos com ética, propósito e foco em ESG, promovendo um futuro mais justo dentro e fora da empresa.


Aqui, você é o centro. E sua jornada importa.

title: Project Manager - Obras De Artes Especiais
description:
Resumo da Vaga

Responsabilidades

  • Liderar o planejamento, execução, monitoramento e encerramento dos projetos de infraestrutura rodoferroviária sob sua responsabilidade, garantindo o alinhamento com os objetivos estratégicos da Quadrante e as expectativas do cliente.
  • Atuar como o principal ponto focal e representante da Quadrante perante o cliente em todas as fases do projeto, estabelecendo e mantendo um relacionamento de confiança e comunicação eficaz.
  • Gerenciar o escopo, cronograma, custo, qualidade, recursos e riscos dos projetos, aplicando as melhores práticas de gerenciamento de projetos.
  • Acompanhar o desenvolvimento e o progresso dos projetos, atuando na interface com os Líderes de Equipe e as equipes técnicas para assegurar o alinhamento e a comunicação com o cliente.
  • Atuar na interface com o cliente em todas as questões relativas à gestão de contratos , incluindo acompanhamento de termos, comunicação sobre aditivos e suporte na resolução de pleitos, em colaboração com as áreas jurídica, financeira e de operações.
  • Colaborar estreitamente com os Líderes de Equipe e as equipes multidisciplinares internas e externas, garantindo a integração das atividades, o fluxo de informações e o alinhamento com os objetivos do projeto.
  • Monitorar o cumprimento das normas técnicas, regulamentações ambientais, de segurança e de qualidade, interagindo com os Líderes de Equipe e as equipes responsáveis para assegurar que as diretrizes sejam aplicadas e reportar o status ao cliente e à diretoria.
  • Elaborar relatórios gerenciais e de progresso para a alta direção da Quadrante e para os clientes, apresentando status, desvios e planos de ação.
  • Identificar oportunidades de otimização e inovação nos processos e na execução dos projetos.


Requisitos

  • Formação superior completa em Engenharia Civil, de Transportes, ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência sólida e comprovada (mínimo de 8 anos) na gestão de projetos de grande porte em infraestrutura, com foco em obras rodoferroviárias.
  • Experiência substancial e aprofundada com Obras de Arte Especiais (OAE), incluindo conhecimento em planejamento, acompanhamento e interface técnica.
  • Expertise comprovada em gestão de contratos complexos, com habilidade para atuar como ponto focal nas comunicações e discussões contratuais com o cliente.
  • Conhecimento aprofundado das metodologias e melhores práticas de gerenciamento de projetos (PMI, PMBOK, etc.).

description:
Who We Are

Cint is a pioneer in research technology (ResTech). We are feeding the world’s curiosity

Cint seeks a Senior People Operations Associate to join our People Operations, reporting to the People Operations Manager. The Senior People Operations Associate is responsible for:

As a Senior People Operations Associate, you will work closely with the Global People Team supporting them on internal employee queries, be part of various processes (on and off boarding, changes in employment, working with local People Partners supporting local processes), and own administrative work. You will thrive working in a fast-paced environment and enjoy contributing towards building exceptional employer branding. The successful candidate will be a self-starter who loves building relationships, has verbose technical acumen, a passion for streamlining processes, and provides excellent customer service internally with the top-notch candidate and employee experience externally.

  • Execute new employee onboarding, including offer documentation and contracts
  • Execute leaver offboarding processes and coordinate with other functions for a smooth exit.

  • Update, maintain, and present reports with KPIs such as turnover rates and hires by each department/region and be able to provide insights and proactive improvements.
  • Support the Payroll department by providing employee information, leaves and employee benefits.
  • Liaise with local IT for hardware issue and collection when needed
  • Support new hires and leavers during their onboarding and offboarding remotely and in person when needed
  • Review and prepare Payroll changes for Payroll processing.
  • Maintain and administer local benefits.
  • Execute background checks and other pre-employment screening.
  • Prepare correspondence, arrange meetings, and process confidential reports and documents.
  • Handle all employee queries, written or verbal with the utmost confidentiality.
Qualifications

What We Are Looking For

  • Proven experience as an HR Administrator/Support or relevant role for at least 3 years.
  • Proven experience in Payroll and Benefits tasks globally.
  • Digital literate with expertise in using Google Suite and MS Office applications.
  • Excellent organizational skills, with an ability to prioritize important projects.
  • Excellent communication skills for in-person, email, and telephone calls.
  • Excellent skills in written English to create reports and meet tight deadlines.
  • Minimum Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience in HR required.
  • An excellent learner with the ability to work in teams.
  • Good problem-solving skills.
  • Basic knowledge of the recruitment process.
  • Present information in forms, tables, and spreadsheets.


Bonus Points If You Have

  • Professionals in Human Resources (PHR), or other HR certifications, are preferred.
  • Thorough knowledge of labour relations and laws.
  • Skilled in performance management and employee benefits administration.
  • Proficiency in using HR software like HRIS or HRMS.

More About Cint

We’re proud to be recognised in Newsweek’s 2025 Global Top 100 Most Loved Workplaces®, reflecting our commitment to a culture of trust, respect, and employee growth.

In June 2021, Cint acquired Berlin-based GapFish – the world’s largest ISO certified online panel community in the DACH region – and in January 2022, completed the acquisition of US-based Lucid – a programmatic research technology platform that provides access to first-party survey data in over 110 countries.

O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparencia, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?


Na Dexian, valorizamos a diversidade.

Acreditamos que diferentes perspectivas, experiências e trajetórias impulsionam a inovação e fortalecem conexões. Por isso, nosso processo de contratação é inclusivo, aberto a candidatos de todas as identidades, habilidades e histórias. Aqui, o que importa é o talento.


O que esperar do seu dia a dia de trabalho

⛳ MISSÃO DO CARGO


Garantir a conformidade fiscal da Companhia por meio da execução eficiente das obrigações principais e acessórias, assegurando suporte técnico às áreas internas e o cumprimento rigoroso das legislações tributárias vigentes e de todos os prazos legais aplicáveis ao nosso negócio. Nosso propósito é contribuir para a sustentabilidade financeira e reputacional da organização, promovendo segurança jurídica, transparência e excelência operacional.


RESPONSABILIDADES PRINCIPAIS — O quê e como?


A área tributária é responsável por revisar e controlar a elaboração do faturamento das empresas do Grupo Jereissati, assegurando a correção dos valores a receber e das retenções tributárias aplicáveis. Compete-lhe identificar e apurar os tributos incidentes sobre faturamento e lucro, utilizando sistemas apropriados e planilhas auxiliares que garantam precisão e confiabilidade nos cálculos;


Atuarádiretamente com tributos indiretos , sendo fundamental experiência em:


  • ICMS — apuração, créditos e débitos, regras de substituição tributária e conferência fiscal;
  • NCM – Classificação Fiscal de Produtos — análise, manutenção e correta categorização dos itens;
  • SPED Fiscal — elaboração, revisão e transmissão das obrigações acessórias (EFD ICMS/IPI), garantindo conformidade com prazos e legislações vigentes.


Também é incumbida de elaborar e dar suporte ao preenchimento das obrigações acessórias federais, estaduais e municipais, cumprindo rigorosamente os prazos estabelecidos pela legislação por meio dos sistemas eletrônicos disponibilizados pelos órgãos competentes.

O departamento prepara as guias de recolhimento dos tributos, observando as diferentes periodicidades do negócio, utilizando tanto os sistemas da Receita Federal quanto sistemas internos;


A áreatambém deve assegurar o correto registro contábil dos tributos no ERP‑SAP, realizando conciliações entre as informações registradas e as bases apuradas, garantindo integridade e transparência nos demonstrativos financeiros.

Outra responsabilidade essencial é atender às demandas internas, fornecendo suporte técnico para esclarecimentos fiscais e organizando o fluxo documental conforme as necessidades da companhia, além de alimentar sistemas eletrônicos e acompanhar atualizações necessárias para assegurar conformidade legal.

title: Product Designer - Pleno
description:
PRODUCT DESIGNER - PLENO

A jornada de quem ama repensar o futuro está aqui.


Sobre a Rethink

Somos uma consultoria que une tecnologia, design e estratégia de produtos digitais para solucionar os desafios de grandes empresas brasileiras. Agora como parte da Framework Digital , ampliamos nosso impacto atuando de ponta a ponta na jornada digital, da concepção à escala.


Nossa missão é gerar valor real por meio de soluções que conectam times, sistemas e pessoas. Acreditamos que a transformação digital acontece quando estratégia, tecnologia e experiência andam juntas e é isso que entregamos.


Empresas como Smiles, Gol, Santander Esfera, Swift e Comgás confiam em nossa parceria para acelerar sua evolução digital com consistência e resultado.

Diversidade e Inclusão

Para repensar o futuro, é essencial garantir ambientes mais diversos e inclusivos . Por isso, incentivamos fortemente a candidatura de mulheres, pessoas pretas, pardas, indígenas, LGBTQIAPN+ e pessoas com deficiência .

Que tal repensar um futuro mais diverso com a gente?

Qual será o seu papel?

Como Product Designer Pleno, você será a ponte entre as necessidades de negócio de um grande player do setor de infraestrutura e as dores dos usuários finais. Seu papel é garantir que cada funcionalidade desenvolvida seja intuitiva, tecnicamente viável e visualmente impecável, elevando a maturidade de design dentro de um ecossistema complexo e dinâmico.


Como será seu dia a dia?

  • Trabalhar próximo aos times de Engenharia, Produto e áreas de negócio para definir e desenvolver soluções eficazes e novas funcionalidades;
  • Identificar pontos de fricção e oportunidades em processos complexos (como faturamento, chamados técnicos ou serviços de gás);
  • Conduzir pesquisas, entrevistas com usuários e testes de usabilidade para validar hipóteses antes da implementação;
  • Liderar dinâmicas de brainstorm e workshops de co-criação com stakeholders;
  • Aplicar princípios de Gestalt, tipografia e hierarquia visual para entregar interfaces de alto nível.


Para esta vaga, é essencial:

  • Apresentação de casos reais, processos de pensamento e entregas visuais com um portfólio online atualizado;
  • Experiência sólida com design de interação, definição de fluxos e prototipação funcional;
  • Experiência prática em entrevistas, testes de usabilidade e métodos como card sorting e avaliação heurística;
  • Habilidade paratrabalhar com bibliotecas de componentes e manter a consistência visual;
  • Domínio de ferramentas como Figma, Adobe XD, Sketch ou similares;
  • Conhecimento emDesign Thinking, Lean UX e metodologias centradas no usuário;
  • Disponibilidadepara atuação híbrida em São Paulo/SP;
  • Graduação ou cursos especializados em Design, UX ou áreas correlatas;
  • Familiaridade com princípios de acessibilidade (diretrizes WCAG) para garantir produtos inclusivos para todos os perfis de usuários;
  • Capacidade de argumentar e defender soluções de design baseadas em dados e evidências junto a stakeholders.


Você pode se destacar se:

  • Tver experiência em consultoria, com facilidade para transitar entre diferentes contextos e lidar com stakeholders seniores;
  • Já tiver atuadocom Design Systems, participando da criação ou manutenção de guias de estilo e bibliotecas escaláveis;
  • Possuir background no setor de Gás e Energia, com compreensão das particularidades, termos técnicos e fluxos de atendimento do segmento de utilities;
  • Tiver perfil analítico, com conhecimento em métricas de uso e ferramentas de análise para embasar decisões de design;
  • Já tiver visão de Produto, atuando lado a lado com PMs na definição de KPIs e priorização de roadmap.

O que oferecemos aos nossos Rethinkers?

Básico que a gente ama

  • Vale Alimentação;
  • Kit de onboarding com todas as ferramentas essenciais e mimos exclusivos para Rethinkers

Saúde e bem-estar

Então, vem repensar o futuro com a gente! ✨

title: Coordenador De Qualidade E Diligenciamento
description:
Sobre a Gruen


Fundada no Brasil em 2020, com sede em São Paulo, a Gruen conta com um time de engenharia atuando tanto localmente quanto na Alemanha o que assegura o desenvolvimento do processo mais eficiente para cada projeto. Nossa missão é entregar a melhor tecnologia para purificação de biogás com o menor consumo de energia entre todos os processos disponíveis no mercado.

Nossas soluções são específicas e feitas sob medida de acordo com a necessidade dos nossos clientes: pré-tratamento do gás, remoção de CO2 e N2, optional CO2 capture and storage ou liquefação, Liquefação de CH4 ou compressão de 250bar – desde o projeto inicial até a gestão da operação da planta, garantindo satisfação total de nossos clientes.

Fabricação e assistência técnica locais resultam em redução de custo e aumento de eficiência.

Soluções para contratos de manutenção e operação das plantas viabilizam a redução da complexidade e de custos.

Nossa motivação é desenvolver soluções viáveis na geração de energia limpa e sustentável para a preservação do nosso planeta e das gerações futuras.

Objetivo : Coordenar, organizar e controlar a documentação técnica de projetos de plantas de biogás, incluindo databooks, manuais de operação e manutenção, garantindo conformidade com normas técnicas, requisitos contratuais e padrões de qualidade da empresa e do cliente.
